8w18:
Bachelor of Arts - Business Management always expanding and seeking creative-minded talent to be the leaders of tomorrow. Make students first step in this fast paced, challenging and, most importantly, exciting sector by studying the Business Management BA(Hons) degree at the University of Huddersfield - London.

This flexible course aims to equip students with the industry knowledge and leadership ability to face challenges and devise creative solutions to problems faced by businesses across multiple industries. By the end of the course, student will be prepared to step with confidence into the workforce as a business leader.

Note : Students are automatically enrolled in a 4-year course, which includes an optional Placement Year. Upon arriving at the University of Huddersfield - London, students can opt for the 3-year course (without the Placement Year) if they prefer. They can change their decision until the end of year 2. If they choose not to take the Placement Year, University will inform the Home Office, and their visa will be adjusted accordingly upon course completion.
8w1a:
Bachelor of Arts (Honours) - International Business aims to equip students with the industry knowledge and leadership ability to face challenges and devise creative solutions to problems faced by businesses across multiple industries. By the end of the course, students will be prepared to step with confidence into the workforce as a business leader.

The global business industry is always expanding and seeking creative-minded talent to be the leaders of tomorrow. Make students first step in this fast paced, challenging and, most importantly, exciting sector by studying the Business Management BA(Hons) degree at the University of Huddersfield - London

International business is a fulfilling and intellectually stimulating field for those interested in the dynamics of the global economy and international relations; even small businesses can now reach an international market. The global business industry is always expanding and seeking fresh talent from all corners of the world.

International Business BA(Hons) degree aims to equip students with the critical thinking skills and industry knowledge to thrive in the international workplace. The modules are designed to foster a deep understanding of various business issues, including Understanding Global Dynamics, Understanding Business Analytics, and Accounting for Managers. Students will gain a global perspective of the business environment, cultural awareness, and strong problem-solving skills.

Note : Students are automatically enrolled in a 4-year course, which includes an optional Placement Year. Upon arriving at the University of Huddersfield - London, students can opt for the 3-year course (without the Placement Year) if they prefer. They can change their decision until the end of year 2. If they choose not to take the Placement Year, University will inform the Home Office, and their visa will be adjusted accordingly upon course completion.
7suy:
Develop advanced knowledge and skills in computing and information technology (IT) with an MSc in Computing at The University of Huddersfield - London.

As a rapidly changing industry, the world of IT is constantly evolving. Our Computing MSc will equip the student with the cutting-edge skills needed for a successful career in this sector. It is an advanced-level course designed to meet the industry demand for computing experts. On this course, the student will:

  • Develop their skills to make critical enquiries and implement analytical approaches to complex IT practice
  • Develop further proficiency in the theory and practice of software development, with the opportunity to specialise in advanced areas of software development
  • Develop the skills to design and construct high quality software systems
  • Gain a deeper understanding of systematic approaches, tools and techniques for systems development and the ability to embed them all within suitable frameworks to enable success. Our aim is to equip the student with the skills for fast-tracking their career in IT.

This programme places significant emphasis on the development of both theoretical knowledge as well as practical skills. Student will experience a variety of teaching methodologies and assessment strategies, and be provided with an interactive learning environment where they can engage in hands-on activities and problem-based learning that are instructor-led.

The Computing MSc can lead to a wide variety of technical career roles, including:

  • Service Desk Analyst
  • IT Consultant
  • Information Security Specialist
  • Software Support Engineer
  • Web Developer
  • Information Systems Manager
  • Head of Information Technology
1v9k:
Develop specialist knowledge of international business while studying in a thriving global business hub. This programme will allow student to gain an in-depth understanding of the rapidly changing and dynamic international environment.

By studying this course the student will develop the skills needed to identify strategies available to global businesses and develop a critical understanding of their activities. The student will study a wide range of topics in international business, from both a theoretical and practical perspective.

The course is designed to enable student to tailor it to their own personal and career interests, with a number of option modules available.

A Master’s in International Business provides students with the opportunity to gain critical understanding of the rapidly changing and dynamic international business environment. In this course, students will develop the skills needed to identify strategies available to firms operating at an international level, and develop a critical understanding of their activities. This programme will provide the opportunity for students to study a wide range of topics in international business, from both a theoretical and practical perspective.

There are five compulsory modules:

  • The Context of International Business
  • The Global Professional
  • The Strategy of International Business

A postgraduate degree in international business leads to a variety of careers, including:

  • Management Consultant
  • Human Resource Manager
  • Global Sales Manager
  • Recruitment Consultant
  • International Account Manager
  • Business Analyst
  • Overseas Trading Specialist
7suv:
The Management MSc provides excellent preparation for a successful global career in management.

Student will gain a deep understanding of professional management principles and practice, and enhance your understanding of the concepts and models that can be used to analyse the strategic issues facing an organisation. The student will also gain knowledge of management areas such as people management and strategy, marketing, and finance, and will learn to apply real-world case studies to develop their leadership capabilities and professional skill set.

The Management MSc at the University of Huddersfield - London allows the student to customise their study programme, offering a number of module options that you can select based on their interests and career ambitions.

By studying a Master’s in Management at the University of Huddersfield - London they will open up a variety of career options in business and management roles. Our career-focused education will ensure they will gain the knowledge, skills, and connections one needs for a successful career.
